name: Theobromine
summary: Theobromine is the principal bitter alkaloid of the cacao bean. It has been used in various pharmaceutical products as a vasodilator, diuretic, and heart stimulant. Theobromine is consumed in cocoa, chocolate, and in various forms of chocolate-based foods. It is also present in small amounts in green coffee beans, tea, mate, and kola nut.

pharmacology.text: Even without dietary intake, theobromine may occur in the body as it is a product of the human metabolism of caffeine, which is metabolised in the liver into 12% theobromine, 4% theophylline, and 84% paraxanthine. In the liver, theobromine is metabolized into xanthine and subsequently into methyluric acid. Important enzymes include CYP1A2 and CYP2E1. The elimination half life of theobromine is between 6 and 8 hours.

summaryZh: 可可鹼（英語：Theobromine），亦稱可可𭺷，是一個甲基黃嘌呤類生物鹼，存在於可可樹和巧克力中。同屬這一類的還有茶鹼和咖啡因。

uses.en: It is eaten mainly in chocolate and cocoa. It has been used in medicine as a mild diuretic, heart stimulant and blood vessel widener.
uses.zh: 人們主要從巧克力與可可中攝取它。它在醫學上曾被用作溫和的利尿劑、強心劑與血管擴張劑。
uses.zhHans: 人们主要从巧克力与可可中摄取它。它在医学上曾被用作温和的利尿剂、强心剂与血管扩张剂。

sideEffects.en: In large amounts it can cause nausea, sweating, trembling, headache and a racing heart.
sideEffects.zh: 大量攝取可能造成噁心、出汗、顫抖、頭痛與心跳加速。
sideEffects.zhHans: 大量摄取可能造成恶心、出汗、颤抖、头痛与心跳加速。

fact.en: Theobromine has nothing to do with bromine. Its name comes from Theobroma, the cacao tree's genus, Greek for food of the gods. It is also why chocolate is poisonous to dogs, which break it down very slowly.
fact.zh: 可可鹼跟溴一點關係也沒有。它的名稱來自可可樹的屬名Theobroma，在希臘文中意思是「眾神的食物」。它也是巧克力對狗有毒的原因，因為狗分解它的速度非常慢。
fact.zhHans: 可可碱跟溴一点关系也没有。它的名称来自可可树的属名Theobroma，在希腊文中意思是「众神的食物」。它也是巧克力对狗有毒的原因，因为狗分解它的速度非常慢。
